(02)Before you come

Five things that make the morning easy.

Good preparation means accurate results and no repeat visits.

  1. 01

    Fast for 10–12 hours

    Nothing to eat after dinner the night before. Plain water is fine and helps the blood draw.

  2. 02

    Take your usual medicines

    Blood pressure and thyroid tablets as normal, with water. Bring diabetes medicines or insulin and take them after the fasting sample.

  3. 03

    Bring what you have

    Photo ID, previous reports, prescriptions and a list of the medicines you take.

  4. 04

    Dress for the tests

    Loose, two-piece clothing makes ECG, ultrasound and X-ray quicker. Leave jewellery at home.

  5. 05

    Tell us first

    If you are pregnant, could be, or are on your period, let us know when booking. Some tests are rescheduled.
